claim_one_line: THE WEAVE'S THEOREMS WITH THE EXCHANGE ADDED: THE COMPUTATION THE OWNER ASKED FOR BEFORE DECIDING HOW 'THE TICK IS AN ACT' STANDS WITH 'EVEN TICKS OBSERVED' (P-769, P-771; data-free; it decides nothing and says what each decision costs): most of what the closure map holds about the weave is unchanged when histories of an odd number of ticks take part -- the two fixed characters, the walk's measure exactly (a run has length r with probability 2^-r in the grammar of L and the tick as in that of L and R) [CORRECTED 2026-11-12 (Review 79): what was computed is the law of run lengths; the measure at every strength of the pull-back, and where the walk's point lies, are not shown unchanged], no fixed point of the modulus, one end for each of the 22 odd histories to 7 letters [which holds by construction: noted 2026-11-12 (Review 79)]. What changes is the hand: on the weave's six-dimensional space the 96 elements and two pieces become 192 and one, the triplet is half of one irreducible six, the group contains its own generalised CP (the triplet's indicator twisted by the exchange is +1 for any lift), and a three whose sign is the hand has no sign left [argued from the joined piece; the index was not recomputed: noted 2026-11-12 (Review 79)]. One thing gets stronger: the tick alone fixes exactly the trivial character and the quaternion point, where the record needs both two-act moves together, so the place where the records sit is singled out by the single founding act; done twice the tick fixes a curve. Whether the joined six is a real representation depends on a phase of the exchange's lift that nothing fixes, so no such statement is made. Not restated: the two negatives that compare with measurement. WITH THIS RESULT IN HAND THE OWNER RULED (2026-11-11, to main, 'A condition to derive'): every tick is in the ledger; 'only even ticks are observed' is no longer a ruling but a condition the weight must deliver; the chiral three stays as conditional as it was; the budget's orientation bit is a named condition to derive, not a declared choice. 0 of 19.
